title: Verdict
description: The verifier's single, typed answer for one claim. Exactly one verdict per claim_id lands in the audit ledger. INCONCLUSIVE and CHECKER_ERROR MUST NOT be rendered as verified.

receipt_version.description: Receipt envelope version. Version 2 binds a named world and canonical payload; omitted for legacy verifier-only verdicts.

receipt_id.description: SHA-256 digest of the receipt-v2 canonical payload.

canonical_payload.description: Deterministic payload hashed into receipt_id. It excludes issued_at and parser-run metadata.

verdict_id.description: SHA-256, first 32 hex chars, of the canonicalized (claim + verdict + derivation + snapshot_hashes + checker_version) tuple. Guarantees tamper-evidence in the ledger.

fault_code.description: Required iff verdict=REJECTED. See spec/fault_taxonomy.md for the closed enum.

reasons.description: Verifier-produced explanation strings. NEVER filled by an LLM. One entry per rule that fired against the claim.

rule_id.description: Stable id of the rule that fired (e.g. `R-CTX-01`, `R-CAUS-02`). Defined in spec/inference_rules.md.

message.description: Verifier's human-readable rendering of the rule's failure. Must not include LLM prose.

evidence_id.description: Evidence record the rule cited, if applicable.

derivation.description: Required iff verdict=ACCEPTED_CONDITIONALLY. Machine-readable trace: which evidence records the verifier consulted, and which rules it applied to accept the claim.

conditions.description: Human-readable list of the scope conditions attached to acceptance. Rendered verbatim in any downstream prose (e.g. `only in K562, resting state`, `only under CRISPRi perturbation`).

checker_error.description: Required iff verdict=CHECKER_ERROR. Explains why the checker itself failed (loader crash, snapshot hash mismatch, rule-engine bug). NEVER auto-repaired into a REJECTED_* verdict; escalates fail-closed.

snapshot_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every snapshot the verifier consulted for this verdict. Two verdicts computed against the same claim under the same snapshot_hashes MUST be identical.

checker_version.description: Semver of the verifier binary that produced this verdict. Bump on any change to the rule engine, resolver, or verdict formatter.
